review.text: I had French Roofing replace my roof a couple summers ago. They were nothing but professional! The job was very well done, and they were so easy to work with. I had a small issue the winter after the work was done and they came out immediately and took care of it, no questions asked. I would recommend Sean and French Roofing to anybody that wants a job well done by a company that knows what they're doing, and at a fair price!
